results.title: Oxford Square Capital Corp. Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call for October 30, 2026
results.description: GREENWICH, Conn., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oxford Square Capital Corp. (NasdaqGS: OXSQ) (NasdaqGS: OXSQG) (NasdaqGS: OXSQH) announced today that it will hold a conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 earnings on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 9:00 AM Eastern time. The toll free dial-in number is 1-800-715-9871, access code number 5885175. There will be a recorded replay of the call available for 30 days after the call. If you are interested in hearing the recording, please dial 1-800-770-2030. The replay pass-code is 5885175#.

results.title: Fort Frances to see new housing units in northern Ontario project
results.description: FORT FRANCES – The town will see 58 new housing units as part of a larger collaboration to create 609 units from Kenora to North Bay.
